status: Separate local upload-ready copy; no GitHub upload or public release performed
scope: Packaging, static notebook inspection, archive integrity, file hashes, and isolated Git checks only

line_ending_protection.git_attribute_check: text unset for notebook, map PNG, and numeric reference CSV
line_ending_protection.isolated_git_staging_check: All intended candidate files included; reference ZIP, checkpoints, environment, and runtime examples ignored

excluded_from_repository: Detailed author working notebooks and sibling working/checkpoint folders
Jupyter checkpoints, runtime/authentication files, environments, logs, and caches
privacy_check: No credential-like tokens or workstation paths detected in scanned source/docs/CSV text, notebook source/text outputs, or the 202 reference-archive members; this is a scoped scan, not a guarantee of all third-party permissions.
scientific_preservation: The notebook, model implementations, source evidence, result tables, manuscript PDFs/LaTeX, and heat maps are copied without changes. Only upload documentation/checksum records and line-ending protection are changed or added.
checks_not_claimed: Execution of the notebook in the new repository
Live GitHub upload or rendering verification
Completion of licensing or third-party distribution approval
pending_before_public_release: Final author approval and code license
Separate data and third-party distribution terms
Actual repository/release download URLs and publication-status wording
historical_checks: Earlier audit reports retain their original dates and scopes. Saved execution counts do not imply cells were executed during this packaging step.
